author: ANTON
description: Gmail via the Google Gmail API v1. OAuth2 required; use an oauth2 credential with scopes gmail.readonly + gmail.send. Workflows are HTTP templates — they execute through the mission api_call task type by referencing this pack's endpoints, or through a future workflow executor that runs them directly.

auth_flow.notes: Create a Google Cloud project, enable the Gmail API, generate OAuth2 client credentials. Store the refresh_token on the credential; the vault's refreshOauthToken() helper handles rotation.

rate_limits.quota_unit_cost: 1 for metadata, 5 for messages.get/full, 100 for messages.send
rate_limits.notes: Per-user quota: 250 units/sec. Batch reads via users.messages.list (pagination) + messages.get rather than threads when you only need metadata.

list_messages.description: List message ids matching a Gmail search query (e.g. 'from:foo@bar.com newer_than:7d').

steps.description: GET — returns { messages: [{ id, threadId }], nextPageToken }

get_message.description: Fetch a single message by id (full format — headers + body).

steps.description: GET — returns the full RFC 5322 payload with headers + parts

send_message.description: Send an email. Body must be a base64url-encoded RFC 5322 message in the request body.

steps.description: POST — composer assembles RFC 5322 from to/subject/body_text params, base64url-encodes, wraps as { raw: ... }. Validates email + strips CR/LF to block header injection.

add_label.description: Apply a label id to a message (e.g. to archive: remove INBOX; to mark read: remove UNREAD).

steps.description: POST — modifies labels on the message

known_issues: OAuth2 refresh tokens issued by Google can be revoked if the user changes their password or the app exceeds inactivity. The vault should detect 401 + invalid_grant and prompt re-auth.
messages.list only returns ids — each message body requires a separate messages.get. Plan api_call task batches accordingly.
Send quota is 100 units/user/sec; bulk outreach should fan out across multiple user mailboxes or use batch endpoints.

fallback_hints.send_message: If the POST fails with 403 'insufficient scopes', the OAuth grant was issued with gmail.readonly only. Re-authorise with gmail.send.
